model: 9L d=512 seq=1024 | 29,421,056 params | 2000 steps | FineWeb sp1024
method: QAT with STE, disjoint train/val shards, 3 seeds (42,123,777), median
key_finding: PTQ↔QAT inversion confirmed on 3 seeds. In PTQ (weight round-trip), e2m5/e3m4 was the best 8-bit pocket; in QAT (training with STE), e2m5 is the WORST arm (+0.27 BPB). FP8 E4M3 with per-row scaling (FP8S) is indistinguishable from FP32 in QAT (Δ=+0.0001, below 0.005 threshold).
mechanism_hypothesis: Narrow exponent (e2m5 range ~7.9) restricts weight dynamics during training — range matters more than grid density in QAT. FP8 E4M3 (range ±448) has enough dynamic range for weight evolution under STE.
honest_limits: 29M params / 2000 steps / 1 model — not H100 scale
Quant-proxy BPB ≈2.83 (NOT comparable to official trained-from-scratch ≈1.05-1.47)
seed=123 collapse in v1 was data leakage artifact (train+val from same shard) — resolved by disjoint shards
